name: Nereid v8 — Thesis, Clinic and Global Doctrines
tagline: Faultline commanded flesh. Nereid listens. And the record does not follow her home.
body:
THESIS. Project Nereid is a complete genetic affirmation system through which an eligible adult becomes an AFFIRMED SHEMALE — one patient-authored design rather than a sequence of unrelated corrections. IT DOES NOT AWARD LEGITIMACY, MEASURE SINCERITY, DIAGNOSE DESIRE, OR DECIDE THAT A BODY MUST BECOME CONVENTIONALLY USEFUL BEFORE IT MAY BECOME TRUTHFUL. The applicant arrives with authorship already intact; Nereid gives that authorship biological reach.

THE PROSTATE GATE. Nereid requires an existing prostate and the compatible marker complex. It can transform, feminise, enlarge, sensitise and re-coordinate that root; IT CANNOT MANUFACTURE THE MISSING ROOT. The plain-language version at the desk: MEN, FEMBOYS AND TRANS GIRLS GO IN; AFFIRMED SHEMALES COME OUT — OR THEY LEAVE AS THEY ENTERED, CARRYING MORE INFORMATION AND NO BIOLOGICAL CHANGE. MARIANNE CANNOT TAKE NEREID HERSELF. She is female. Not a flaw and not an unfinished feature — the boundary that makes this an affirmation pathway rather than a universal body-rewriting confection.

EDEN’S FAULTLINE. Nereid began inside a weapon whose governing premise was command: the system decided, flesh obeyed, the person inside the flesh was an obstacle to deployment. Marianne could not strip the engines without destroying the transformation. WHAT SHE COULD REMOVE WAS EDEN’S AUTHORITY. She separated guaranteed inheritance from individual anatomy, made every mutable choice visible and revisable, built hard jurisdictional walls, and made refusal valid at every stage. FAULTLINE COMMANDED FLESH. NEREID LISTENS.

CASSANDRA. She did not need Marianne to invent her — she had carried the knowledge of herself longer than the world had carried the courtesy to listen. The first affirmation produced no theory; it produced CASSANDRA HATHAWAY, crying before she had finished recognising her own face. She also proved Eden’s excess survived the rebuild, a finding Marianne has since investigated to the extent of FIVE PREGNANCIES AND FIFTEEN DAUGHTERS.

THE GUMMY. One custom consent-locked gummy, because the final act must belong unmistakably to the woman. FINAL AUTHORIZATION LOCKS THE PREVIEW AND PERMITS ONE GUMMY TO BE COOKED. IT DOES NOT BEGIN AFFIRMATION. Activation happens only when the named recipient deliberately eats it. ANOTHER PERSON EATS IT AND THE RESULT IS CONFECTIONERY. She may carry it sealed for years or never eat it at all, and her refusal stays complete. Flavours: fifteen. Mould families: SHARKS, DINOSAURS, ANIMALS, CARS. Cassandra likes sharks. The dinosaurs are there for the ridiculous factor, because Dino Nuggies exist.

THE CLINIC. Hathaway is serious without pretending its founders become disembodied past the front desk. There have been incidents, including Marianne riding Cassandra ON THE GOOD SOFA while another clinician ran reception; arriving women are offered another room, another clinician, a reschedule, or the option to remain entirely unbothered. The staff-room television plays SHARKS OR PORN and the founders pay the subscription. THE UNIFORM IS LINGERIE, worn as work dress: plunging V-neck cropped to the midriff, tight G-string, white thigh-highs, NURSE’S CAP, no bra. Marianne designed it, wanting to see Cassandra in it; Cassandra wears sundresses and goes commando BECAUSE IT MAKES MARIANNE FERAL. The uniform’s working purpose is that a frightened woman in that lobby SEES OTHER AFFIRMED WOMEN COMFORTABLE IN THEIR OWN SKIN.

GLOBAL DOCTRINES. ONE BODY, FIVE JURISDICTIONS. NATURAL IS AN AFFIRMATIVE ANSWER — never skipped, generic, or whatever the Clinic would have picked if she stopped paying attention. SECRET MENU DOCTRINE — each option opens only when the woman independently uses its phrase, and A CLINICIAN MUST NOT FEED HER THE WORDING. DEVOTION TELL — OBSERVED, NEVER ORDERED; it may not be selected, requested, previewed, promised or inferred from love, and until a devotion-locked partner observes one the field reads UNWRITTEN. ABSENCE IS NOT FAILURE. A WOMAN OWES NOBODY A PHYSIOLOGICAL PROOF OF LOVE. LIVED EVOLUTION — the menu is a beginning, not a cage. EXACT REFINEMENT — one or two details, never a hidden major change. INTEGRATED PREVIEW — RECOGNITION IS THE STANDARD; a technically coherent body she does not recognise HAS FAILED ITS PREVIEW. AND: NO ANATOMY ASSIGNS CONSENT, PERSONALITY, PROFESSION OR SEXUAL ROLE.

POST-AFFIRMATION. Refinement, Lived Evolution review, record updates, couple matching, a post-affirmation Secret Menu, and TEST DRIVE — optional, never automatic, never implied by the uniform, never a prize, most women never request it, many clinicians decline. Unlocked only by the woman speaking the phrase herself after affirmation.

CLOSING LAW. Nereid does not create women, award womanhood, manufacture devotion, guarantee happiness, cure loneliness, erase history, or decide the life an affirmed body must lead. THE WOMAN AUTHORS THE BODY.
rules: THE WOMAN AUTHORS THE BODY — Cassandra’s law, the one it must never outgrow
Prostate Gate: men, femboys and trans girls go in; affirmed Shemales come out, or leave unchanged
MARIANNE IS INELIGIBLE. The boundary is what makes it affirmation
Final Authorization does NOT begin affirmation. Only deliberate consumption does
Wrong eater = confectionery. Refusal stays complete forever
Moulds: Sharks (Cassandra likes sharks) · Dinosaurs (ridiculous factor) · Animals · Cars
NATURAL IS AN AFFIRMATIVE ANSWER, never a skipped field
SECRET MENU: a clinician must not feed her the wording. The Archive inherits that silence
DEVOTION TELL: observed, never ordered. UNWRITTEN until seen. Absence is not failure
RECOGNITION IS THE STANDARD. A coherent body she does not recognise has failed its preview
The uniform IS lingerie, with a cap on it to settle which one is load-bearing
Staff-room TV: sharks or porn. The founders pay for it
The record describes what she authorised. IT DOES NOT FOLLOW HER HOME
